meta.name: central-core-total-wireframe
meta.designIntent: Combined Central Complex wireframe with map-prototype-2 proportions: left wing F7-F3, central core G6-I7, right wing J7-J3, over a narrower/deeper central-complex ground plate.

mapPrototype2GroundPlate.source: map-prototype-2.html CAMPUS_BLOCKS central bounds F7-J3 with buildingPad

centralCore.note: Core compressed to three middle columns and two ranks.

mapGroundPlate.bounds: 6 tiles x 7 tiles from map-prototype-2 visual count

groundPlate.note: Ground plate uses 6:7 x/z tile ratio; wing outer edges sit on the plate x-boundaries.

latestAdjustment.leftDetails: added F6 exit and distinct colonnettes/windows
latestAdjustment.parallelNote: wing mass/roof/caps now use matching widths and shared Z center/depth so depth edges project parallel

shouldersHalvedDepth.note: Shoulders halved on Z-axis and centered on main_hall_mass to align with central core.

latestRightWingDetailDistribution.note: Right wing details redistributed explicitly after wing length changes; shoulder attachment zone remains clear.

meta.centralCoreEdgeMode: normal total export restored to hiddenEdges=partial
meta.referenceImageObservation: Compared with the pasted PNG, the central core should read as a lower horizontal portico/dome composition: broad low hall, shallow shoulder blocks, and a dome that rises from a low drum. The wings are long low courtyard bars with detail rhythms; they should not tower over or visually equal the main hall.
